A subscription, and a price per document.

The plan buys seats, an allowance and a monthly credit. Beyond the credit you pay for what you file and what you generate, one click at a time. Nothing is ever charged without a click.

30 days, full use, no card.

Seats are free during the trial and $5.00 of metered credit is granted. Memoranda generated in the trial stay downloadable afterwards.

What is metered

EventPriceCharged when
Document filed$0.25Once per part, at the moment you accept the proposal. A twelve-page scan split into three documents is three charges.
Memorandum generated$1.00Once per generated memorandum, whatever its length and however many documents it draws on.
Screening and market datanot yet pricedThird-party lookups. Not available at launch, and never called without a further explicit action.

The same eighteen documents then support a KYC memorandum and a vendor memorandum at $1.00 each. They are not re-read and not re-charged.

What is not charged

  • Editing your configuration, at any time
  • Publishing a new revision
  • Adding, retitling or reordering a section
  • Binding a different set of facts to a section
  • Renaming a fact, including on memoranda already written
  • Reading or downloading anything already generated
  • Opening a new file on an entity named in a memorandum
  • Sharing, within your plan allowance
  • A recipient reading a memorandum you shared
  • Parts blocked for having no text layer

When your balance runs out, filing and generation stop. Reading, downloading and editing your configuration continue.
